summary: All 25 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes. I reproduced all 45 paired gene directions, including all ten in Figure 2E. These cover 45 of 65 reported genes (69.2%), below the 90% concordance threshold. The corrected proposal retains the selected-results comparison, qualifies the tissue description and documents the ambiguity in the authors’ significance cutoff. It passed the repository proposal validator.
openIssues: The registry says whole hypothalamus. GEO describes hypothalamus slices. The exact dissection extent remains unspecified. [GEO sample record](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSM4809664)

Figure 2A labels its axis as P value, while the methods specify BH-adjusted P. The original DESeq2 table and selection code were not located, so the gene-wise author FDR calls and exact rule behind the 65 reported genes remain unresolved. [Li et al.](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8126977/)
